## How it was checked

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes (or `pnpm verify --fast`, and say why the real-app suites didn't run)
- [ ] Editor or typography changes checked in the real app against `docs/specimen.md`, Arabic and mixed lines included
- [ ] UI changes: before and after screenshots in both themes, and the five design-review questions (DESIGN.md §18) answered below
- [ ] File-handling changes come with a failure-path test
- [ ] `cd web && pnpm verify` passes, if it touches `web/`
